lessons.title: A Fair Test Needs a Record
lessons.goal: 區分實驗觀察、推測與紀錄的限制。
lessons.story:
Nora’s science group wants to compare two paper towels. They pour ten spoonfuls of water onto a tray and use one sheet to soak it up. Then they repeat the test with the other brand.

The first towel leaves one spoonful on the tray. The second leaves three. Nora writes these numbers in a table. Her partner says, “Let’s write zero for our favorite brand. It will look better.”

Nora refuses. A useful record shows what happened, not what the group hoped would happen. She also notices that their sheets have different sizes. Perhaps the larger towel takes up more water simply because it is larger.

They decide to test equal-sized pieces next time. For now, their report includes the measured amounts and the size difference. It does not name one brand as the winner.

words.example: We compare two kinds of paper towels.
Repeat the test with clean water.
A useful record includes the real numbers.
Nora refuses to change the result.

questions.prompt: How much water remains after the second towel is used?
questions.explanation: 第二款留下三匙；一匙是第一款結果。
questions.evidence: The first towel leaves one spoonful on the tray. The second leaves three.
reasons: 直接對應 second leaves three。
零是夥伴想捏造的數字。

questions.prompt: What difference does Nora notice between the sheets?
options: Both have holes in the center.
questions.evidence: She also notices that their sheets have different sizes.

questions.prompt: Why does the group avoid naming a winning brand?
options: Both towels leave the same amount of water.
The favorite brand has no name.
Sheet size may affect the result.
questions.explanation: 尺寸差異可能解釋吸水量，不宜僅靠本次測試判定品牌優劣。
questions.evidence: Perhaps the larger towel takes up more water simply because it is larger.
reasons: 殘水量為一與三，並不相同。
把可能影響結果的其他因素納入判斷。

questions.prompt: What does “record” mean in this passage?
options: A piece of music for the group.
A new brand of paper towel.
A prize for the fastest student.
questions.explanation: 上下文是表格與報告，record 指記下的實驗資料。
questions.evidence: A useful record shows what happened, not what the group hoped would happen.
reasons: 對應紀錄實際發生的事。

questions.prompt: How much water does the first towel take up in this test?
questions.explanation: 起始十匙、殘留一匙，吸走十減一等於九匙。
questions.evidence: They pour ten spoonfuls of water onto a tray and use one sheet to soak it up.

questions.prompt: Which statement best matches Nora’s approach?
options: Ignore all measurements until every test is perfect.
Change weak results to support a favorite choice.
Use larger pieces only for the favorite brand.
Report the real results and explain what limits the comparison.
questions.explanation: Nora 同時保留實測值並交代尺寸差異，並非隱藏資料。
questions.evidence: For now, their report includes the measured amounts and the size difference.
reasons: 下次要用同尺寸，不偏袒品牌。
同時包含誠實紀錄與限制說明。
